communications.subject: Charge inquiry - TXN-952871447
communications.body:
Hi,

I noticed a charge of $45 on my statement from Food Delivery App. I would like to understand this charge and request a resolution.

Regards,
Eleanor Vance

communications.subject: RE: Charge inquiry - TXN-952871447
communications.body: I immediately contacted the Food Delivery App's customer service via their in-app chat function on February 10, 2026. I explained the issues with the cold, congealed pasta and the incomplete/wilted salad. They apologized for the inconvenience and offered me a $10 credit for a future order. I rejected this as unsatisfactory because the entire meal was a write-off and not what I paid for. I requested a full refund, but they refused, stating their policy only allows for partial credits or re-delivery in some cases, neither of which I found acceptable given the quality and missing items.
